_note: Peoples (cultural/linguistic groupings) and the nations that belong to them today. match = regex on the Federal Register name; extra/exclude = nation ids. Self-designations come first where nations use them. Everything here is a draft until reviewed. Rule: when a nation identifies itself as a distinct people, or names itself differently, its own word governs here.
